Name: Instant Pets and Farm Caves
Author: bblueberry
Description:
[size=3]Are you a mod creator with so much stuff to test? Do you find yourself dreading every new save file?
Is it because your mod's a pile of broken junk, or is it because MARNIE'S BACK WITH THAT DARN CAT?? ?
[b][size=4]IS DEMETRIUS GETTING ON YOUR NERVES WITH HIS STUPID CAVE? ??HECK YEAH HE IS[/size][/b]

[size=4]NOW YOU CAN JUST START WITH THE DARN CAT AND THE SMELLY CAVE!![/size]
OR NEVER SEE THEM EVER AT ALL ITS UP TO U
I DONT MAKE THE RULES ONLY DUMB MODS

[b]IF YOU'RE NOT A MOD CREATOR[/b] then you're totally fine to download this mod actually
EVERY feature is optional and has to be enabled in the config or console
you can install this mod just for the console commands if you like!! still up to u
[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xUXoHNK.png[/img]
[list]
[size=3]
[*][b][color=#a4c2f4]Instant Pets[/color][/b] — Sets pet preferences immediately and opens the new pet menu; provided you don't already have a pet.
[*][b][color=#a4c2f4]No Pets[/color][/b] — Marnie will never appear to choose your pet.
[*][b][color=#a4c2f4]Cat Person[/color][/b] — Sets pet preference to cats; or dogs if not enabled.

[*][b][color=#a4c2f4]Instant Cave[/color][/b] — Sets farm cave preferences immediately; regardless of your current cave choice.
[*][b][color=#a4c2f4]Empty Cave[/color][/b] — Demetrius will never appear to choose your cave.
[*][b][color=#a4c2f4]Mushroom Person[/color][/b] — Sets cave preference to mushrooms; or fruit bats if not enabled.
[/size][/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xYXOyrn.png[/img]
[list]
[size=3]
[*][color=#b4a7d6][b]pet.reset[/b][/color] — Reset your pet to its default state.
This will erase pet friendship progress.
[*][color=#b4a7d6][b]pet.species[/b][/color] — Swap the farm pet from cat to dog, and vice versa.
    Pet friendship will be preserved.
[*][color=#b4a7d6][b]pet.breed[/b][/color] — Set the breed for your pet. Use [b][font=Courier New]1/2/3[/font][/b] to choose the breed.
Pet friendship will be preserved.
[*][color=#b4a7d6][b]pet.rename[/b][/color] — Rename the farm pet.
   Pet friendship will be preserved.
[*][color=#b4a7d6][b]pet.clear[/b][/color] — Clear all farm pets.
This will erase pet friendship progress.

[*][color=#b4a7d6][b]cave.type[/b][/color] — Swap the farm cave from mushroom to fruit, and vice versa.
This will clear any mushroom boxes.
[*][color=#b4a7d6][b]cave.clear[/b][/color] — Clear the farm cave to neutral, producing neither mushrooms or fruit.
  This will clear any mushroom boxes.
[/size][/list]
